foils.code:
def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==7]
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    rows=[r for r,c in cells if c==c0]
    mid=(min(rows)+max(rows))//2
    for c in range(c0+1,W): g[mid][c]=7
    return g

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==7]

        for c in range(c0+1,W): g[mid][c]=7
    else:
        for c in range(0,c0): g[mid][c]=7
    return g
